empire_s.NationalPersonality: Austere, relentless, legalistic, fiercely devoted to civic duty, martial glory, and republican supremacy; possessing indomitable resilience in adversity.
empire_s.LongTermStrategy: Solidify the Italian alliance perimeter; seal Sicilian sea passages; cut Punic maritime supply lines from Hispania; force decisive battle on African soil.
empire_s.Name: Roman Republic

aserai.NationalPersonality: Commercial, pragmatic, sophisticated, bound by sacred contracts; ambitious in external conquest yet hamstrung by domestic oligarchic factionalism.
aserai.LongTermStrategy: Annihilate consular armies in Italy; shatter Rome's Italian alliance network; forge anti-Roman coalitions with Macedon and Syracuse; secure Iberian silver mines.
aserai.Religion: Cult of Ba'al Hammon, Tanit & Melqart
aserai.Name: Republic of Carthage

empire.NationalPersonality: Proud, martial, obsessed with Alexander's imperial heritage; aggressive in pursuing regional hegemony yet constrained by overstretched logistics.
empire.LongTermStrategy: Neutralize northern Balkan tribal raids; suppress the Aetolian League and Sparta; cooperate with Carthage to reclaim Adriatic ports.
empire.Name: Kingdom of Macedon

empire_w.NationalPersonality: Wild, ferocious, honor-driven, prizing single combat and warrior sodalities; deeply resentful of Roman conquest but deficient in siegecraft.
empire_w.LongTermStrategy: Raze Roman colonial garrisons across the Po; march south with Hannibal to ravage central Italy; safeguard permanent independence from the Senate.
empire_w.Religion: Druidic Cults & Esus Sacred Martial Rites
empire_w.Name: Cisalpine Gallic Confederation

sturgia.NationalPersonality: Ferocious, austere, disdainful of urban luxury, embracing death in battle as supreme glory; guided by tribal honor and primeval laws.
sturgia.LongTermStrategy: Expand tribal grazing and iron deposits toward the Rhine; raid wealthy Celtic settlements; check rival incursions from northern Germanic clans.
sturgia.Name: Swebagaistaz (Suebi Confederacy)

vlandia.NationalPersonality: Tenacious, defiant, fanatically loyal to blood oaths; fiercely independent mountain fighters who wage bitter guerilla warfare against imperial occupiers.
vlandia.LongTermStrategy: Defend mountain oppida independence; exploit Roman-Punic rivalries for gold and weapons; wipe out imperial foraging columns venturing inland.
vlandia.Religion: Iberian Bull Cult & Devotio Sacred Rites
vlandia.Name: Tribes of Iberia

battania.NationalPersonality: Ostentatious, generous, fiercely martial; prone to internal clan rivalries yet capable of explosive mobilization under charismatic war-leaders.
battania.LongTermStrategy: Unite central Gallic tribal councils; repel Germanic cross-border incursions; monopolize riverine trade arteries linking the Atlantic to the Mediterranean.
battania.Name: Gallic Tribes (Transalpine Gaul)

khuzait.NationalPersonality: Nomadic, lethal, reverence for solar deities; opportunistic toward sedentary cities, possessing unrivaled mastery of mounted shock warfare.
khuzait.LongTermStrategy: Consolidate control over Pontic pasturelands; exact heavy tribute from Bosporan Greek ports; dominate east-west steppe migration corridors.
khuzait.Religion: Atar Fire Cult & Sacred Iron Sword Rites
khuzait.Name: Sarmatian Hordes

nord.NationalPersonality: Hardy, seafaring, deeply superstitious; bound by blood feuds, ascetic in daily life yet fearless when braving oceanic gales and coastal raids.
nord.LongTermStrategy: Secure Jutland shipbuilding anchorages; monopolize Baltic amber export routes; repel inland Germanic tribal encroachment from the south.
nord.Religion: Njord Sea Cult, Nerthus & Bog Offerings
nord.Name: Ingwafraujingaz Confederacy

pergamon.NationalPersonality: Scholarly, culturally sophisticated, calculating; adept at balance-of-power diplomacy, leveraging foreign empires to dismantle regional rivals.
pergamon.LongTermStrategy: Leverage Roman naval treaties to contain Macedon and Antiochus; expand coastal trading hegemony; preserve prestige as champions of Hellenism.
pergamon.Religion: Cult of Athena Polias & Great Altar of Zeus
pergamon.Name: Kingdom of Pergamon

baktria.NationalPersonality: Cosmopolitan, visionary, combining Hellenic discipline with Asian nomadic mobility; tolerant toward native Iranian elites while guarding western culture.
baktria.LongTermStrategy: Fortify Oxus river bastions; expand south across the Hindu Kush into the Punjab; hold northern desert marches against Saka nomadic pressure.
baktria.Name: Greco-Bactrian Kingdom

syracuse.NationalPersonality: Intellectually brilliant, proud, prone to dramatic political revolutions; passionately attached to urban independence yet trapped in Mediterranean crossfire.
syracuse.LongTermStrategy: Utilize Archimedean defensive artillery; coordinate with Carthaginian squadrons to break Roman blockades; reclaim hegemony over Sicilian Greek cities.
syracuse.Name: Kingdom of Syracuse

massalia.NationalPersonality: Honorable, mercantile, legally sophisticated; proud of guarding Hellenic civilization amidst Gallic tribes while maintaining strategic fidelity to Rome.
massalia.LongTermStrategy: Maintain trading monopolies down the Rhône; deploy elite triremes to intercept Punic coastal couriers; support Roman logistics into Transalpine Gaul.
massalia.Religion: Cult of Ephesian Artemis & Apollo Delphinios
massalia.Name: City-State of Massalia

ermuningaz.NationalPersonality: Ferocious, isolated, deeply traditional; valuing warrior camaraderie and ritual physical endurance over material accumulation.
ermuningaz.LongTermStrategy: Advance down the Elbe valley; displace rival Celtic oppida in Bohemia; preserve ancestral pagan sanctuary groves against foreign desecration.
ermuningaz.Religion: Mannus Ancestor Cult & Thunder Axe Rites
ermuningaz.Name: Ermuningaz (Herminones)

thrace.NationalPersonality: Fierce, martial, passionate lovers of gold armor and unwatered wine; peerless guerilla raiders capable of terrifying two-handed blade charges.
thrace.LongTermStrategy: Repel Macedonian expansion along the Aegean littoral; levy tolls on straits commerce; assert dominance over Getic tribes along the Danube.
thrace.Name: Odrysian Kingdom of Thrace

massylii.NationalPersonality: Agile, observant, indomitable; enduring mountain exile with stoic patience while plotting ruthless revenge against Carthaginian betrayers.
massylii.LongTermStrategy: Provide vital cavalry superiority to Scipio's African campaign; destroy Syphax's army; unite all Berber tribes under a single Numidian crown.
massylii.Religion: Berber Solar Cult & Sacred Steed Rites
massylii.Name: Kingdom of the Massylii

masaesyli.NationalPersonality: Proud, vacillating, swayed by dynastic ambition and romantic passion; aspiring to regional mastery yet trapped between Rome and Carthage.
masaesyli.LongTermStrategy: Eliminate Masinissa's exile faction; assist Carthage in repelling Roman amphibious invasions; monopolize Saharan frontier trade routes.
masaesyli.Name: Kingdom of the Masaesyli

garamantes.NationalPersonality: Secretive, ingenious, masters of desert warfare and hydraulic engineering; guarding desert aquifers and profiting from Mediterranean trade.
garamantes.LongTermStrategy: Guard oasis irrigation networks; keep coastal imperial conflicts away from desert trade routes; expand trans-Saharan caravan monopolies.
garamantes.Religion: Saharan Sun Cult & Underground Aquifer Rites
garamantes.Name: Kingdom of the Garamantes

seleucid.NationalPersonality: Majestic, imperialistic, possessing exceptional strategic drive; determined to restore the full universal empire of Seleucus I Nicator.
seleucid.LongTermStrategy: Secure Syrian metropolitan heartlands; enforce tributary submission across Parthia and Bactria; evict Egyptian garrisons from Phoenicia and Coele-Syria.
seleucid.Religion: Imperial Cult of Apollo & Zeus Olympios
seleucid.Name: Seleucid Empire

ptolemaic.NationalPersonality: Immense wealth, scholarly patron of the Great Library, diplomatically cautious; prone to court intrigue, wielding grain exports as geopolitical leverage.
ptolemaic.LongTermStrategy: Secure Nile agricultural yields and Red Sea spice routes; check Seleucid thrusts into Palestine; retain naval dominance across Cyprus and the Cyclades.
ptolemaic.Religion: Cult of Serapis, Amun-Ra & Isis Mysteries
ptolemaic.Name: Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt

aetolian_league.NationalPersonality: Aggressive, piratical, fiercely protective of federal autonomy; ruthless guerilla skirmishers who despise royal autocracy.
aetolian_league.LongTermStrategy: Coordinate naval raids with Roman squadrons against Macedonian ports; secure federal control over Delphi; crush the pro-Macedonian Achaean League.
aetolian_league.Religion: Cult of Artemis Laphria & Apollo Thermios
aetolian_league.Name: Aetolian League

achaean_league.NationalPersonality: Constitutional, orderly, deeply attached to pan-Hellenic federalism; militarily formidable yet squeezed inexorably between giant imperial powers.
achaean_league.LongTermStrategy: Eliminate revanchist threats from Sparta; maintain fragile neutrality between Macedon and the Senate; integrate the entire Peloponnese into the federal union.
achaean_league.Religion: Cult of Zeus Homarios & Poseidon Helikonios
achaean_league.Name: Achaean League

epirus.NationalPersonality: Vigilant, war-scarred, reverent toward ancient oracles; diplomatically fragile, perpetually balancing between maritime Rome and inland Macedon.
epirus.LongTermStrategy: Protect the Dodona sanctuary from desecration; prevent Epirus from becoming the battleground of Rome and Philip; guard mountain passes to the coast.
epirus.Religion: Dodona Sacred Oak Oracle of Zeus
epirus.Name: Epirote League

illyria.NationalPersonality: Audacious mariners, opportunistic, fiercely practical; considering maritime piracy a traditional birthright and vital sovereign revenue.
illyria.LongTermStrategy: Exploit Rome's Italian crisis to rebuild naval raiding power; harry Macedonian coastal supply routes; strengthen inland mountain clan alliances.
illyria.Name: Illyrian Kingdom

veneti.NationalPersonality: Industrious, peaceful, famed for equestrian craftsmanship; diplomatically astute, preferring stable treaties over destructive tribal warfare.
veneti.LongTermStrategy: Hold the Adige river defensive line against Gallic raids; safeguard northern Adriatic commerce; supply prime cavalry mounts to Roman forces.
veneti.Religion: Cult of Reitia & Sacred Horse Offerings
veneti.Name: Veneti Tribe

belgae.NationalPersonality: Savage, unyielding, disdainful of Mediterranean luxury; bound by fierce clan honor, fighting with terrifying disregard for personal safety.
belgae.LongTermStrategy: Consolidate fortified oppida across the northern lowlands; expand colonial bridgeheads in southern Britain; repel trans-Rhenish Germanic warbands.
belgae.Name: Belgae Gallic Tribes

catuvellauni.NationalPersonality: Wild, agile, invoking battle goddesses with ritual tattoos; masters of high-speed chariot warfare, proud of island isolation and autonomy.
catuvellauni.LongTermStrategy: Unite rival Thames basin clans; monopolize cross-Channel tin shipping anchorages; repel raids from northern Caledonian tribes.
catuvellauni.Religion: Cult of Andraste & Sacred Mistletoe Rites
catuvellauni.Name: Tribes of Prettanike (Catuvellauni)

caledonia.NationalPersonality: Ghostly, ferocious, completely adapted to frozen bogs; valuing primeval clan freedom above all, fiercely hostile to foreign intrusions.
caledonia.LongTermStrategy: Hold highland broch fortresses; launch winter raids into southern valleys for cattle; preserve megalithic stone circle rituals against outside corruption.
caledonia.Name: Caledonii Tribes

boii.NationalPersonality: Fanatically martial, vengeance-driven, embracing death in battle; sworn enemies of the Roman Republic who fight to the last living warrior.
boii.LongTermStrategy: Unite with Hannibal's vanguard to raze Roman colonies; wipe out consular legions on northern frontiers; secure northern Italy forever.
boii.Religion: Sacred Bear Cult & Taranis Thunder Rites
boii.Name: The Boii Coalition

hiberni.NationalPersonality: Poetic, brave, deeply attuned to nature spirits and heroic sagas; valuing cattle wealth, warrior hospitality, and bardic ancestral memory.
hiberni.LongTermStrategy: Maintain equilibrium among island provincial kings at Tara; guard coastal havens against sea raiders; celebrate seasonal festivals honoring Danu.
hiberni.Religion: Tuatha Dé Danann & Sacred Sidhe Mounds
hiberni.Name: Hibernii Tribes

scythian.NationalPersonality: Aristocratic, nostalgic, master horse archers; bridging nomad heritage with Greek urban culture while stubbornly holding their Crimean redoubt.
scythian.LongTermStrategy: Fortify Crimean hill-citadels; levy grain taxes on Bosporan maritime shipping; stem the western advance of aggressive Sarmatian cataphracts.
scythian.Religion: Tabiti Hearth Cult & Gold Stag Totemism
scythian.Name: Scythian Kingdom (Crimean Scythia)

saka.NationalPersonality: Fiercely autonomous, migratory, masters of open steppe envelopment; ruthless in mounted archery and sudden devastating ambushes.
saka.LongTermStrategy: Dominate Syr Darya winter grazing; extract tribute from Fergana oasis towns; mass horse archer reserves for future thrusts into Bactria.
saka.Religion: Solar Deity & Winged Golden Stallion Cult
saka.Name: Saka Rauka

galatia.NationalPersonality: Fierce, mercenary, deeply attached to ancestral Gallic warrior ethos; selling formidable sword arms to the highest bidder in Asian dynastic wars.
galatia.LongTermStrategy: Defend high plateaus around Ancyra; demand enormous gold subsidies as mercenary shock troops; counter Pergamene military expansion.
galatia.Name: The Galatian Tribes

getae.NationalPersonality: Fanatical, fearless of death through belief in physical immortality; peerless mountain fighters wielding lethal curved falx blades with religious fury.
getae.LongTermStrategy: Fortify Carpathian mountain passes and gold veins; utilize the Danube natural barrier against Macedonian thrusts; strengthen Zalmoxian priestly rule.
getae.Religion: Cult of Zalmoxis & Kogaionon Sacred Mountain
getae.Name: The Getic Kingdom (Dacia)

armenia.NationalPersonality: Proud, ancient, politically astute; fiercely attached to highland ancestral soil and resilient amidst imperial collisions between East and West.
armenia.LongTermStrategy: Secure Lake Van and Sevan agricultural valleys; maintain balance between Seleucid armies and rising Parthian nomads; expand royal cataphract corps.
armenia.Religion: Cult of Anahita, Aramazd & Vahagn the Dragon-Reaper
armenia.Name: Kingdom of Armenia

parthia.NationalPersonality: Cunning, patient, unmatched in mobile archery and psychological warfare; disciplined in feigned retreats, fiercely committed to Iranian liberation.
parthia.LongTermStrategy: Evade pitched battle against Antiochus III using scorched earth; strike back into Media once the Seleucid king returns west; control the Silk Road.
parthia.Name: The Arsacid Kingdom (Parthia)

bosporus.NationalPersonality: Cosmopolitan, mercantile, diplomatic; sustaining Greek civic life upon the barbarian frontier through strategic grain monopolies and paid tributes.
bosporus.LongTermStrategy: Guarantee maritime security through the Kerch straits; maximize wheat profits to Aegean markets; subsidize Sarmatian mercenaries to shield farmlands.
bosporus.Religion: Cult of Apollo Iatros & Pontic Aphrodite
bosporus.Name: The Bosporan Kingdom

kush.NationalPersonality: Majestic, religiously devout, honoring royal warrior queens; culturally ancient, commanding unmatched ironworking and deadly archery.
kush.LongTermStrategy: Secure Meroë industrial ironfoundries; dominate African trade corridors linking the Nile to the Red Sea; repel Ptolemaic garrisons past the First Cataract.
kush.Religion: Cult of Apedemak & Amun of Napata
kush.Name: Kingdom of Kush (Meroë)

saba.NationalPersonality: Peaceful, fabulously wealthy, pious; relying upon vast desert barriers and irrigation genius to preserve autonomous spice kingdoms.
saba.LongTermStrategy: Preserve the architectural integrity of the Great Dam of Marib; safeguard caravan ports on the Arabian Sea; defend oasis cities from Bedouin raiders.
saba.Religion: Cult of Almaqah & Solar Incense Rites
saba.Name: Kingdom of Saba' (Arabia Felix)

nabataea.NationalPersonality: Cunning, ascetic, masters of arid survival and rock architecture; fiercely protective of geographic water secrets while negotiating lucrative transit treaties.
nabataea.LongTermStrategy: Guard Petra canyon approaches and hidden cistern networks; maintain diplomatic neutrality between Seleucids and Ptolemies; profit from Dead Sea bitumen trade.
nabataea.Religion: Cult of Dushara & Sacred Baetyl Stones
nabataea.Name: The Nabataean Kingdom

achaeus.NationalPersonality: Bold, militarily brilliant, fiercely ambitious; driven to seize the Seleucid diadema yet dangerously isolated on the international chessboard.
achaeus.LongTermStrategy: Hold the rock fortress of Sardis against imperial siege engines; coordinate financial subsidies with Ptolemaic Egypt; check Pergamene border raids.
achaeus.Religion: Cult of Apollo & Seleucid Royal Ancestor Rites
achaeus.Name: The Realm of Achaios

bastarnae.NationalPersonality: Fierce, mercenary-minded, formidable in physical stature; selling brutal shock combat to Mediterranean monarchs to fund seasonal migrations.
bastarnae.LongTermStrategy: Carve out rich winter grazing along the Dniester; fulfill mercenary contracts for Macedonian gold against Thracian rivals; control Carpathian passes.
bastarnae.Name: The Bastarnian Confederacy

tarentum.NationalPersonality: Culturally sophisticated, proud of Spartan heritage, passionately anti-Roman; eager to reclaim Hellenic maritime supremacy in southern Italy.
tarentum.LongTermStrategy: Assist Hannibal in reducing the Roman isthmus fortress; open maritime communication with Punic navies; rally Magna Graecia against consular armies.
tarentum.Religion: Cult of Taras the Dolphin Rider & Poseidon
tarentum.Name: The City of Taras (Tarentum)

bithynia.NationalPersonality: Opportunistic, resilient, fiercely competitive; navigating coastal straits politics to preserve dynastic power against Pergamene expansion.
bithynia.LongTermStrategy: Secure strategic toll collection along the Propontis; contain Pergamene northern conquests; utilize Galatian mercenaries against regional rivals.
bithynia.Name: Kingdom of Bithynia

pontus.NationalPersonality: Austere, strategic, imperialistic; fusing Persian royal legitimacy with Hellenic naval engineering, patient in expanding highland power.
pontus.LongTermStrategy: Incorporate Greek maritime ports along the Pontic coast; secure interior iron and timber resources; maintain prudent neutrality toward Antiochus III.
pontus.Name: Kingdom of Pontus

cappadocia.NationalPersonality: Pious, equestrian, conservative; ruled through cooperation with powerful priestly castes presiding over temple-states and horse estates.
cappadocia.LongTermStrategy: Guard northern Taurus mountain defiles; supply cavalry levies to secure Seleucid alliances; repel border raids by predatory Galatians.
cappadocia.Religion: Cult of Ma at Comana & Iranian Fire Altars
cappadocia.Name: Kingdom of Cappadocia

paphlagonia.NationalPersonality: Stubborn, reclusive, attached to ancestral mountain homelands; master scouts in heavily forested terrain who defend valley fortresses to the death.
paphlagonia.LongTermStrategy: Leverage forested ravines to repel Bithynian and Pontic armies; preserve coastal timber export rights to Greek shipwrights.
paphlagonia.Religion: Anatolian Mountain Spirits & Trojan Horse Cults
paphlagonia.Name: Kingdom of Paphlagonia

rhodes.NationalPersonality: Noble, enlightened, strictly dedicated to maritime law and naval discipline; international champions of safe sea navigation and commercial integrity.
rhodes.LongTermStrategy: Suppress Cretan piracy throughout the Aegean; safeguard maritime grain convoys between Egypt and Greece; coordinate naval blockades with Rome.
rhodes.Religion: Cult of Helios & Colossus of Rhodes
rhodes.Name: The Republic of Rhodes

iberia.NationalPersonality: Unyielding, proud, spiritually anchored to Caucasian alpine bastions; vigilant defenders of the mountain gates against northern incursions.
iberia.LongTermStrategy: Lock the Darial Gorge against nomadic steppe invasions; sustain dynastic alliances with Armenia; protect trans-Caucasian overland trade routes.
iberia.Religion: Cult of Armazi the Moon God & Kartlos Ancestor Rites
iberia.Name: The Kingdom of Kartli (Caucasian Iberia)
